item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:35 HKT 25/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will affect the coast of Guangdong today. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, the weather will be slightly cooler over the region on Wednesday. It will be windier in the following couple of days. With the monsoon moderating over the weekend, temperatures will rise gradually over the coast of Guangdong.

Date/Month: 25/04 (Tuesday)
Wind: Northeast force 2 to 3.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Visibility rather low in some areas at first.
Temp range: 22 - 25 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
